Floor Plans and Build-up Areas – Designed for Every Homebuyer

Brigade Orchards offers a variety of unit configurations tailored to different needs. Whether you are a single professional, a growing family, or an investor, the project has an ideal home for you.

Perfect for singles and young professionals, the 1 BHK units feature compact yet functional layouts. With a smartly designed floor plan, these units maximize space efficiency while offering a cozy living environment.

1.5 BHK Apartments (764 sq. ft.)

The 1.5 BHK homes offer an additional half-room, ideal for a home office, study, or guest room. This configuration is perfect for young couples or remote workers seeking extra flexibility.

2 BHK Apartments (878 – 948 sq. ft.)

Designed for small families, the 2 BHK homes provide a perfect blend of space and comfort. The well-planned floor layout ensures seamless movement and ample natural light. These homes feature spacious bedrooms, a modern kitchen, and a cozy living area.

3 BHK Apartments (1131 – 1338 sq. ft.)

For larger families or those who love extra space, the 3 BHK apartments at Brigade Orchards offer the ultimate luxury. These units boast expansive living areas, elegant interiors, and top-notch fittings, making them a perfect dream home.
